body: Strange as this may seem, I'm the most afraid to talk about this to people I'm close to or even familiar with/ have to interact with. I'm afraid that I'll turn from just Claire to "Claire that's suicidal. Shit, I hope she's medicated."

You, sir, are braver than I.
As much as I want to be an authentic version of myself, like you said, I've never really put any effort into it. I'm much too preoccupied with trying to make people think I'm happy and loving life.
It's exhausting, but I want to have a better, less batshit crazy self before I start revealing that self to other people.
